text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】std_usage_qty: line_qty / base_qty
【衍生】lower_level_demand_qty: SUM(project.demands.required_qty) * std_usage_qty / COALESCE(yield_rate, 1)

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】open_order_qty: MAX(order_qty - received_qty - cancelled_qty - closed_unreceived_qty, 0)
【触发】冻结供给排除待核查: supply_type == 质检冻结库存

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】closing_qty: opening_qty + arrival_qty + other_inflow_qty - fulfilled_qty - other_outflow_qty
【衍生】unmet_carry_qty: required_qty - fulfilled_qty

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】risk_qty: MAX(remaining_qty - reserved_qty - post_period_consumed_qty, 0)
【衍生】risk_amount: risk_qty * material.cost_unit_price
【触发】呆滞风险触发: risk_qty ＞ 0

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;
text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;
text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】rebuilt_closing_qty: rebuilt_opening_qty + received_in_qty - consumed_out_qty
【衍生】simulated_reducible_qty: MAX(baseline_risk_qty - intervened_risk_qty, 0)

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: 【触发】换料未到货检查: approve_status == 已批准 且 evidence_status == 完整

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【触发】授权数量变化重核算: change_type == 授权变化
【触发】替代关系变化复核分配: change_type == 替代关系变化
